  repository multiple
  times.

  Worktrees are
  particularly valuable for
  frequent context
  switching: fixing an
  urgent production bug
  while deep into feature
  development, running long
  parallel test suites
  across different
  versions, or reviewing
  peer pull requests side-
  by-side. Git also
  enforces safety by
  preventing two worktrees
  from checking out the
  exact same branch at the
  same time, preventing
  collisions.

  Once finished, cleanup is
  quick and straightforward
  using git worktree remove
  <path>, leaving the
  central repository
  pristine. Overall, Git
  worktrees provide an
  elegant, lightweight
  solution for multitasking
  without disrupting
  ongoing work or
  sacrificing local storage
  efficiency.

──────────────────────────────
